title: Deep reinforcement learning still in early stages
description: Systems combining deep learning with reinforcement learning are in their infancy, though they already show promising results on vision tasks and game playing.
canonical_description: combination of deep learning and reinforcement learning underdeveloped

evidence.anchor: deep learning and reinforcement learning are in their infancy
evidence.quote: Systems combining deep learning and reinforcement learning are in their infancy, but they already outperform passive vision systems <sup>99</sup> at classification tasks and produce impressive results in learning to play many different video games <sup>100</sup>.
